lineage.description: Agricultural surveillance data collected through systematic field monitoring of sampled parcels in Timbuktu and Youwarou regions from July 2023 to January 2025. Observations include crop phenology stages, rainfall and irrigation water availability, temperature stress, and estimated production outcomes. Spatial parcel boundaries are provided as shapefiles to enable geographic analysis of agricultural drought impacts.
